note.title: Chapter 3.II · Core vocabulary
note.overview: Learn the 24 supplied Chapter 3.II words; each was checked against the Year 9 vocabulary book.
learningGoals: Recall the taught forms and facts independently.
Apply them to translation and GCSE-style questions.
Use the answer and individual mark points to improve precision.
summary: Learn the 24 supplied Chapter 3.II words; each was checked against the Year 9 vocabulary book.
Learn nouns with gender and genitive; learn verbs with their infinitive and useful principal parts. Adjectives must change to agree with their nouns.
Practise the core list separately from related revision words. For derivatives, give a genuine English derivative and its meaning.
